title: Blackium
description: This Resource Pack is Black & White btw.
body:
# Important

> **BlackiumPvP** is an Addon for **Blackium**, made for PvP. If you want to use **BlackiumPvP**, click on Versions and download **BlackiumPvP**, and make sure to place it above **Blackium** in the resource pack list.

<details>
<summary>Example Image</summary>

![Resource Pack list with correct Order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15f54e39d685909de4a92fadfffb64dabde9eee4.png)

</details>

## Features

- Complete GUI overhaul
- Custom sky
- Blue Diamonds
- Dark Netherite
- White Iron
- Tweaks
- And much more...

## Required Mods

This pack requires two mods to work correctly:

- _**[Recolor](https://modrinth.com/mod/recolor)**_  (White XP and additional Hardcoded Colored Stuff)
- **_[OptiFine](https://optifine.net/home)_** or **_[Skyboxify](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyboxify)_** (Custom Sky)

## Featured Mods

This pack also features two additional mods:

- **_[Apple Skin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)_**
(Food Bar Support)
- **_[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat)_**
(Dark Icons build in)
- **_[uku's Armor HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukus-armor-hud)_**
(Other Warning Icon)
